title: 10 YEARS HIV instantly cleared! This can only be the POWER of God!
paragraphs: the woman with HIV marriage and break to come on here HIV negative my name is I came from Zambia it was I came on Sunday we had Papa was busy praying for people but I couldn't lose up I couldn't like back out I was saying no no this is my time I had that fear but I said no I'm gonna stay for the second service talk about he just stepped in and then after that you just say that woman who've got

HIV can you please come forward to me the woman with HIV marriage and break to come on here the throne ouch unclean Spirit of Darkness foreign thank you HIV negative after they pray for me on Sunday I took that pill I feel like there's something against what's worrying me here and then I told my sister in the morning I said I take the medicine but I feel like something is touching me what did me and then I get on another day

I took it the medicine was so bitter but from that time I never took them in sin and then on Monday I went to the hospital I take the test and then they came negative and then I was so shocked and then I went home and then I was sure my brother-in-law I said look what is happening I said are you sure I said okay try again and then I said no let me go to the hospital again I went to

a picture and they want to show someone you can just take the picture and then go and show them we can't go give you that information that's what they told me I've been sick for so long but I don't remember like a which day was that but it is the time that I was going to work about 10 years here so I've been taking those medicine after they told me that you're HIV you are positive you can go to the hospital

I said I couldn't believe I took that paper I teach I throw it in the toilet I throw it I was so crying and then my mother she was not there and then I said what am I going to tell my mother what am I going to explain to her my mama my mother but encouraged me he told me that fine people that have been sick and watched for so long and what what I try to talk the medicine I try
